summary.summary: The milestone completed 12 experiments in 2.9 minutes, and 4 were compute-bound. The adapter-readiness benchmark led compute time, followed by the matched live-agent canary; adapter readiness is the only stated constraint, and no cause is available for the canary duration. The locked task-level classification reports no GPU idle on compute-bound work, while the available data does not explain multi-model dispatch.
